name: centry-us-portugal-planner
description:
Organise cross-border people, income, accounts and entities into a shared fact and document pack, separate jurisdiction responsibilities, retain unresolved assumptions and quote account notices. No tax liability or filing obligation is determined. Centry does not provide US tax advice.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Centry does not provide US tax advice. No liability, filing obligation, treaty relief or tax-residence decision; notices are literal supplied evidence. Centry does not provide US tax advice. A country in the pack does not establish Centry professional coverage. No tax amounts, treaty relief, filing obligations or legal residence conclusions are determined. Notice highlights are literal supplied text, not verified provider policy. Read the full original notice. Source links establish where text was supplied, not corroboration or authenticity of manually entered facts. No messages, filings, transactions or document sharing occur.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).
